title: What the agent said is a line in the log like any other, not a box
name: text-lines
description: In apps/dashboard/src/logs/Logs.tsx a `text` or `answer` line renders inside its own bordered, surfaced, padded box (`rounded border bg-[var(--surface)] px-3 py-2 font-sans`), while every other kind is a bare span in mono. The box came in with node the-run-panel-a-box-for-what-the-agent-s-5svv; beside the tool rows it now reads as a second vocabulary in the same list. Take the box away: a text/answer line sits in the same `<li>` flex row, with its mark (`·` for text, `›` for answer, in TONE colours) in the same mark column, and its body as a span — ink colour, sans font, `whitespace-pre-wrap`, max-width 68ch kept so long prose still wraps. Markdown rendering in the body stays as it is (node agent-written-text-renders-as-markdown-w-zvh8). Keep the thinking spinner exactly as is. Update apps/dashboard/src/logs/Logs.test.tsx: a text line has no border/surface classes and shares the row structure of a tool line; the answer mark still points the other way.

brief.approach:
A small change, and it moves the screen toward the approved mockup (`docs/design/watch-the-run.html`), where agent text is a plain `⏺` line with no box.

1. `apps/dashboard/src/logs/Logs.tsx` (line ~172): for `text` and `answer` lines, replace the boxed `<div>` (`rounded border bg-[var(--surface)] px-3 py-2`) with a `<span>` in the same row structure a tool line uses. Keep:
   - `whitespace-pre-wrap break-words`
   - `max-w-[68ch]`
   - `font-sans`
   - `text-[var(--ink)]` (the other kinds stay `--ink-dim`)
   The mark column already holds `·` for text and `›` for answer in their `TONE` colours; leave that as it is. Leave the thinking dot exactly as it is. Do not add a markdown renderer: the comment above `LogScreen` explains why this screen shows text as typed.
2. `apps/dashboard/src/logs/Logs.test.tsx`: rewrite 'prose renders in a box and a tool call does not' as 'prose is a line like any other'. Assert that:
   - a text line's element has no `border` or `bg-[var(--surface)]` class;
   - it sits in an `<li>` whose first child is the aria-hidden mark span, the same structure as a tool line;
   - the answer line's mark is still `›`.
Nothing else changes. tool-blocks rewrites this rendering later, and this node only removes the second vocabulary now.

acceptance.proves: text lines render without a box, share the row structure of a tool line, and the answer mark still points back
no boxed surface is left in the run log
